verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a hosted email and productivity service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any AI assistant or task-delegation feature inside Fastmail. The documented features are filters, search, templates, scheduled send, snooze, Masked Email and the JMAP API, none of which is an in-product AI agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
